The '''Grand Imperial Quartet''' were a [[Band/Legends|band]] of [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] that played together during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Consisting of two [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]] players and two [[strummer]]s, the quartet played on the upper ring of the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the war, a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Fleet]]. The members, three [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], had played on a circular stage behind a bar, and their enlarged images where [[Hologram/Legends|holographically]] displayed above their heads.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Grand Imperial Quartet were created for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
